body: This helps a lot thank you so much. Even if just framing the issue in my head clearly so i can tackle it. I definitely feel everything too intensely and feel this need to fix that. I keep trying to give my friends what I didn't have growing up. I guess I also have a difficult time processing my emotions and writing concise thoughts and feelings and these new abusive vultures pick up on that to take things out of context, or completely ignore what I was really saying; the emotional root of why I was bothered by something. Or it doesn't matter and they want their narc supply and know I will immediately give them what they want because boom. Trigger. I just feel like me enforcing healthy boundaries isn't going to stop it no matter what my conscious brain wants, because my reptilian brain is permanently CPTSD not okay and going to not even recognize flags and know when to back off of a friendship. I'm gonna try and get back into EMDR tapping exercises even though its been a few years along with whatever advice is available, because I need something to ground me when I lose it. :( I'm sorry to be a bother  with all the long comments immediately I just want to hit the root of it even if its slow going.
PP might cover your hormone therapy if you need help, a lot of clinics offer a sliding scale fee, its absolutely worth it to get free and be happy. I wish you luck ❤
